QuestInfo.name: [Neo Tokyo] Zipangu's Guardians
QuestInfo.0: The struggle could not be avoided before the great magical power of the man that attacked the Akihabara Command Center, but you were able to somehow defeat him. That power is of Maple World... Did #p9401533# know? Return to #m876004000# and confirm.
QuestInfo.1: The stranger's name was #p9401520#. He was one of the three Guardians of ancient Zipangu. The third Guardian, #p9401521#, is neither here nor there...
QuestInfo.2: Asia told you about the three Zipangu Guardians, including herself, and how they factor into the end of Zipangu. Return to 2102 Tokyo and prepare for the Alliance's final operation.
